import java.util.*;

    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] ifac = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] fa = new int[19][1 << 19];
    static int[][] fc = new int[19][1 << 19];

    static void addMod(int[] a, int[] b, int p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            a[i] = (a[i] + b[i]) % p;
        }
    }

    static void subMod(int[] a, int[] b, int p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            a[i] = (a[i] - b[i] + p) % p;
        }
    }

    static int[] powConvol(List<Integer> a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.size();
        if (k == 1) {
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) res[i] = a.get(i);
            return res;
        } else if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int) ((res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * a.get(j)) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = powConvol(a, k >> 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int) ((res[i + j] + (long) r[i] * r[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int[] subsetPowConvol(List<Integer> a, int k, int p) {
        int logn = 19;
        int n = a.size();
        while ((n & (n - 1)) != 0) n++;
        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = j < a.size() ? a.get(j) : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], n, p, false);
        }
        int[] fRes = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] va = new int[logn];
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {

            }
            va = powConvol(toList(va), k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = va[j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], n, p, true);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, boolean invert) {
        int k = 31 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int msk = 0; msk < n; msk++) {
                if (((msk >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    int pmsk = msk ^ (1 << i);
                    if (!invert) {
                        a[msk] = (a[msk] + a[pmsk]) % p;
                    } else {
                        a[msk] = (a[msk] - a[pmsk] + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static List<Integer> toList(int[] arr) {
        List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int v : arr) list.add(v);
        return list;
    }

    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long r = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = r;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static long lcm(long a, long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }

    static long fpow(long n, int k, int p) {
        long r = 1;
        long base = n % p;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) r = (r * base) % p;
            base = (base * base) % p;
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static int inv(int a, int p) {
        return (int) fpow(a, p - 2, p);
    }

    static int sign(double x) {
        if (x < -1e-9) return -1;
        if (x > 1e-9) return 1;
        return 0;
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int nn = n;
        int[] f = new int[1 << 20];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {

                    }

        fac[0] = 1;

        }

        List<Integer> a = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(nn + 1, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) {
            a.set(i, ifac[f[i]]);
        }

        long res = fpow(k, n, p);
        int[] aArr = subsetPowConvol(a, k, p);
        int val = (int) ((long) aArr[nn] * fac[n] % p);
        res = (res - val + p) % p;
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
